description:
Perform a land use change analysis using a Union overlay.

1. Open QGIS.
2. Load the two land use layers: `/home/ga/GIS_Data/landuse_2015.geojson` and `/home/ga/GIS_Data/landuse_2025.geojson`.
3. Perform a Union overlay (Vector > Geoprocessing Tools > Union) to create a new layer containing boundaries and attributes from both years. Use `landuse_2015` as the Input Layer and `landuse_2025` as the Overlay Layer.
4. Open the attribute table of the resulting union layer. Enable editing and open the Field Calculator.
5. Create a new Decimal (double) field named `transition_area_sqkm`.
6. Calculate the area of each feature in square kilometers using the expression `$area / 1000000` (since the source data is in meters/UTM).
7. Save edits and export the attribute table as a CSV file to `/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/change_matrix.csv`. Ensure the output includes the class fields from both years and the calculated area.
